__broaden__.αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.: ’which’ (with τε, in a simile) · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl., with γε: ’they, those’
__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a conditional clause after εἴ ποτε: ’if there ever comes to be’ · also in an indefinite relative clause with κε: ’proves, turns out’ (κρείσσων γένηται ’proves the stronger’) · also after ὅπως in an indirect question: ’how … may come about, turn out’ · also in a prohibition or negative wish after μή: ’let it not become’
__broaden__.κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’ · also masc. nom. sg., attributive: ’evil’ (πόλεμος κακός ’evil war’)
__broaden__.μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’)
__broaden__.μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
__broaden__.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’)
__broaden__.τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
__broaden__.ἄργός: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. acc. sg. (accent from enclitic τε) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition to a noun in the nominative (Ἄργός τε Σπάρτη τε ’Argos and Sparta’)
__broaden__.ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly, heartily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’pleasing’ (φίλον καὶ ἡδύ ’dear and pleasing’)
__broaden__.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’)
__broaden__.τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made ready, has come to pass’ · also with a predicate noun: ’has been made, has become’ (ταμίης τέτυκται ’has been made steward’)
__broaden__.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’)
